Privacy policy

This policy covers https://ktkwmr.com/ (the list of apps) and what all the apps on ktkwmr.com have in common. Each app also has its own privacy policy, which explains what the app does with the files you open (see “Each app” below). In short: the music, charts, and recordings you use in the apps stay on your device.

1. Operator

ktkwmr (an individual). Questions: GitHub Issues.

2. Your files

The apps work inside your browser. The files you open, what you type, and what you record are processed on your device and are not uploaded. What an app saves in your browser (settings, recent songs) is listed in its own policy; you can remove it by clearing the site's data in your browser.

3. Information sent outside

ServiceWhenInformation sentPurpose

Some apps also download libraries or an AI model from other hosts (such as jsDelivr or Hugging Face). Each app's policy lists them. Your files are not sent with them.

4. Cookies

The site uses cookies only for analytics:

  • Your choice in the cookie banner (set by Cloudflare Zaraz when you choose), so the banner is not shown again. One choice applies to every app on ktkwmr.com.
  • A random ID for Google Analytics, only if you choose “Accept all”, to count returning visits. It does not contain your name or other personal details.

You can change your choice at any time from “Cookie settings” at the bottom of each page. There are no ads.

5. Analytics

Page views are counted with Cloudflare Web Analytics, without cookies and without tracking visitors across sites.

Only if you agree in the cookie banner, Google Analytics (through Cloudflare Zaraz) also records how the apps and guides are used, so we can improve them: the pages viewed and for how long, where you came from, the buttons and links tapped and the settings changed (by name, and for settings their value), how long sound was played, and the kind, length, number, and result of what an app did (such as “an MP3 file of 4 minutes, separated in 40 seconds”). Each app's policy lists exactly what it records.

File names, titles, the names you give to things, what you type, and the music, charts, and recordings themselves are never sent. The data goes to Google from Cloudflare's servers (your browser does not connect to Google), with the end of your IP address removed. Google signals and advertising features are turned off, and the data is kept for 14 months. See how Google uses information from sites that use its services. If you choose “Reject all”, or do not choose, nothing is sent to Google Analytics.
